{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
total_mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

total_mean_revenue"}
